title: Whoop statement
description: A big, light, tightly tracked display heading with a plain paragraph under it on phones and beside it on desktop, optionally followed by a large photo frame with 30px corners (square on phones, wide on desktop) whose picture zooms in a touch on hover.
notes: the original uses it for several plain heading-and-text sections; leave out showMedia for text only
name: whoop-statement

props.name: body
props.description: the paragraph (leave out for a heading alone)

props.name: showMedia
props.description: show the photo frame under the text

props.name: media
props.description: the photo, filling the frame (object-cover); a grey placeholder when empty
